notes.title: LOA Steam Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025289/e4c468f3a4c2ee4dc6ccf8b9750341bae92b8723.jpg[/img]

The first month you playing on Steam will have a 20% Off when purchasing StarStones.

Sorry for the delay of game release on Steam,We add a special Gift Code for Steam players!

[b]2023STEAMGO[/b]
[b]LOASTEAM[/b]

Please bear in mind that you can not use your old account on LOA Steam version,you can only select the server and your account will be linked to your Steam account.

notes.title: LOA is available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025289/a97f772b83e8276301a846923677803f7b231f4e.png[/img]
Let's go!
The first month you playing on Steam will have a 20%Off when purchasing StarStones.We also have a special Gift Code for Steam players!
